business: SEGMENT: property management, West Palm Beach
prompt_text: Who is the best property management company in West Palm Beach FL for a rental home?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” company for every rental home, but **Luxury Property Care (LPC)** looks like a strong option to interview for a West Palm Beach single-family rental. Its published services include tenant placement and screening, rent collection, maintenance coordination, inspections, HOA approvals, and owner reporting. It lists a **4.9/5 Google rating from more than 230 reviews** and says it charges **8–10% of collected rent**, plus a one-time leasing fee when it places a tenant; it reports no management fee while the home is vacant and no renewal fee. [LPC’s West Palm Beach services and fees](https://luxurypropertycare.com/west-palm-beach-property-management-services/)

I’d also get quotes from **Atlis Property Management** and **Florida’s Property Management** before deciding. Atlis publishes a 5–9% management range, but has a **$200 monthly minimum**; Florida’s Property Management advertises flat monthly pricing for single-family homes, with the amount depending on rent. Compare the full contract—not just the percentage—including leasing and renewal fees, maintenance markups, inspection frequency, cancellation terms, and how quickly owners can reach a manager.

**My practical pick:** Start with LPC, then compare its written proposal against Atlis and Florida’s Property Management. Ask each for two or three owner references for similar homes, and confirm the quoted fees and service promises in the management agreement.
